answer: Weight accrues only as nectar metered from one undivided cedar stand with 40 trees locked 12 epochs under line meters. The rate doubles after each 3 undivided epochs, from 1 liter per tree to 8, so a split restarts both halves at base rate and one flow can never feed two accounts. Boundary willow cuttings root in one epoch; auditors replay the meter logs and survey the roots each close, and a duplicated line, a gap, or a rootless boundary voids the yield. One honest agent locks 40 trees once, recovering them after epoch 12; 1,000 fakes lock 40,000 trees and lose the doubling per re-split.
